roleInAcademy: Primary historical source package, not an Academy course to be rewritten.
authorityRule: Shattering retains ownership of its prequel/High Era production canon. Academy history and political-science courses may excerpt, reconstruct, and analyze it but may not silently change Shattering facts.
sourceBridge: Provide event chronology, telemetry, logs, institutional behavior, Liora Virelia's actions, BHA/Cooperative context, collapse phenomenology, and later-divergence seeds to Academy courses.
Where Academy source-caption passages derive from Shattering dialogue or documents, preserve exact source wording unless the adaptation explicitly identifies paraphrase.
Keep mature Core/Verge/Shard/Crown/Fleet identities from being projected backward into the stable High Era unless the source establishes the precursor relationship.
reconciliationNeed: Crosswalk harmonic terminology and failure phenomena with reciprocal-field/asymptotic-inversion development material without treating compatibility as proof of identity.
